TO: gentoo-guru@lists.gentoo.org
SUBJECT: [PATCH] media-video/graft: new package

-----BODY-----
I have read and agree to the GURU project rules:
https://wiki.gentoo.org/wiki/Project:GURU

This is an initial contribution via the mailing list, as required
for new contributors before an access request.

graft is a local-first composition workspace. Incremental compiler
for video. Runtime ffmpeg via shell-out (media-video/ffmpeg).
Build with virtual/rust.

  https://github.com/eonik-ai/graft
  https://github.com/eonik-ai/graft/releases/tag/v0.2.2

crates.io crate name graft is a different program (orbitinghail).
This source is github.com/eonik-ai/graft.

Signed-off-by: Abinash Senapati <abinashsena@gmail.com>
---

+# Copyright 2026 eonik
+# Distributed under the terms of the GNU General Public License v2
+
+EAPI=8
+
+CRATES=""
+inherit cargo
+
+DESCRIPTION="Change the hook. Keep the body."
+HOMEPAGE="https://github.com/eonik-ai/graft"
+SRC_URI="https://github.com/eonik-ai/graft/archive/refs/tags/v${PV}.tar.gz -> ${P}.tar.gz"
+
+LICENSE="Apache-2.0"
+SLOT="0"
+KEYWORDS="~amd64 ~arm64"
+
+RDEPEND="media-video/ffmpeg"
+DEPEND="${RDEPEND}"
+BDEPEND="virtual/rust"
+
+src_configure() {
+	cargo_src_configure --bin graft
+}
+
+src_install() {
+	cargo_src_install --path crates/graft
+	dodoc README.md
+}
